prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Before merging:** run `/cilium-pre-merge-check`. Cilium 1.20.x fails the BPF verifier on this kernel, which breaks kubelet host-to-pod probes cluster-wide. Verify `Host: BPF` and a real probe returns 200 before merging. See `docs/postmortem-kubelet-probe-outage.md`.

⚠️ WordPress core lives in the container filesystem, not the `wp-content` PVC. Whatever tag is pinned here is what a restarted pod runs — a self-applied update inside the pod is discarded on restart. Merging this is what makes the version durable.

To take a security release before the 7-day cooldown expires, tick this update on the Renovate Dependency Dashboard under **Pending Status Checks** to force the PR immediately. Editing the tag by hand also works and is faster.
⚠️ **Before merging:** run `/adguard-pre-pull` — AdGuard's `Recreate` rollout strategy plus `ctrl-1`'s DNS pointing only at AdGuard itself means a cold image pull will fail with `ImagePullBackOff`.
